limitations: Shared nodes; CPU pinned to one core. GPU baseline/candidate were separate Slurm allocations on node1.
GPU force endpoint timings are under memcheck; do not interpret them as normal execution performance.
Only 7-AO forces and 14/28-AO energy endpoints are qualified here; public force domain remains <=12 AOs.
Baseline 56-AO CUDA run hit its 30-minute limit before completing cold execution. Candidate job 5358 remains separate and is excluded until complete.
CUDA source_seconds measures submission; provider_seconds and total endpoint seconds include consumed source work.
The measured candidate source patch preceded clang-format-only changes in 9636f32dd. Source archive, patch and binary hashes are recorded in environment provenance.

oracle.basis: Exact repository basis-pack primitives, not the independently rounded named STO-3G basis.
oracle.force: Corrected CCSD(T) Lambda amplitudes passed to the analytic gradient.

row_encoding: Merge each record row_defaults.correlation/performance with the corresponding row dictionary; row entries override defaults.
timing_boundary: Prepared one-item public batch execute with host-returned energy/forces. Constructor and prepare time are added to the cold endpoint fields. Initial cold, two retained-owner repeats, then changed geometry. No speedup claim; other host compilation activity was present.
